title: Let waiting ripen into listening
summary: Listening turns waiting from bitterness toward honor. Let honor return to the delay.
takeaway: Let honor return to the delay.
lifeApplication: Before the complaint takes the room, let one quiet line turn waiting toward honor.

source.lifeApplication: At the next delay, listen before you let resentment narrate the wait.
